name: git-workflow
description: A repository workflow toolkit with detached PR and issue desks whose explicit actions run visible, ephemeral agents.

interface.shortDescription: Drain pull request and issue queues safely.
interface.longDescription: Serve pull requests and issues from local/provider JSON as a wizard — approvable, to reject, doubtful, your own to merge or fix, issues to close or hand over — prepared in background by read-only agents for what is new or changed, with sanitized live progress and every approved action run visibly in the attached chat.
defaultPrompt: Use $pr-triage to show what needs my attention.
Use $git-desk to open the pull request and issue desk.
